sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit, before any margin (cost:340010).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
To support the volume and contract length we propose:
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Could you lift your allocation to 22230 units per year?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We acknowledge your volume forecast and accept the 24-month contract for 23,400 units per year. A lead time of 35 days is unfeasible; we must maintain 54 days to ensure reliable supply. Based on these parameters, we propose a unit price of €31.90. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We present a price of €34.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 35 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit. This option comprises a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
We accept these terms; please confirm.

Your on-time delivery averaged 80.7% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70410@2026Q3, sc:70410@2026Q2, sc:70410@2026Q1, sc:70410@2025Q4).
We noted the report "Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH allocates volumes" (news:20260822-23).
To support the price in our term sheet:
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
Could you explain the reason behind the limit you stated?

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. We confirm the agreement on the accepted terms of €31.90 per unit, 23,400 units per year, and a 56-day lead time. The volume allocation you noted is a strict requirement driven by our high capacity utilization to ensure reliable supply. We will proceed with our standard commercial procedure to finalize the contract.

Our offer stands at a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
